test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The courier service had delivered the parcel.

options.text: The parcel service was being delivered by the courier service.
The parcel delivered the courier service.
The parcel had been delivered by the courier service.
The parcel was been delivered by the courier service.

solution:
The correct answer is "**The parcel had been delivered by the courier service.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice is formed by using the auxiliary verb 'be' + past participle of the main verb.
 
• **In this sentence, the past perfect tense 'had delivered' will be changed to 'had been delivered' in passive voice.**
